name: names-long-name-two-octet-length
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): names is SEQUENCE OF with no size constraint: length 2, then each Name; the first label has 130 characters, so its length determinant is 10 00000010000010 (128 <= n < 16384), then 130 x 7 bits; the second is length 1 and one character. 1068 bits, padded with 4 zero bits to 134 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
